no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: XOMA transformed in 2017 into a royalty aggregator. It does not conduct in-house clinical trials. Its portfolio consists of economic rights (milestones and royalties) on >120 commercial and pre-commercial therapeutic candidates owned and developed by third-party licensees. All historical XOMA-sponsored clinical trials are completed, terminated, or suspended. There is no active company-owned P1/P2/P3 program.

10k.note: Confirms royalty aggregator business model; no internal clinical pipeline.

website.note: Site presents royalty portfolio of partner programs; XOMA does not run its own trials.

ctgov.note: All XOMA (US) LLC sponsored studies are COMPLETED, TERMINATED, or SUSPENDED.

commercial_product.note: XOMA receives royalties on third-party commercialized products including DAYBUE (trofinetide, Acadia), VABYSMO (faricimab, Roche/Genentech), OJEMDA (tovorafenib, Day One Bio), and others. These are partner-owned commercial assets, not XOMA pipeline.

excluded_legacy_terminated: Gevokizumab (anti IL-1 beta) - multiple Phase 2/3 programs in pyoderma gangrenosum, Behcet uveitis, non-infectious uveitis, osteoarthritis, acne, AIED - all terminated or completed without advancement (out-licensed to Novartis / Servier historically).
XOMA 052 / XOMA 358 / Opebacan / HCD122 / Efalizumab - legacy XOMA-sponsored programs, all completed/terminated.
excluded_partner_owned: All current royalty assets (Acadia DAYBUE, Roche VABYSMO, Day One OJEMDA, Rezolute RZ358, Janssen, Takeda, etc.) are owned and clinically developed by partners; classified as partner-owned, not XOMA pipeline.
